title: Merge /runs into /workflows as Active Runs tab, kill standalone route
description:
The standalone /runs route exposes a leaky abstraction. Runs belong inside /workflows.

**Changes:**
1. WorkflowsPage gets two tabs: "Templates" (existing workflow cards) and "Active Runs" (current RunsPage content)
2. Remove /runs route from App.tsx
3. Remove "Runs" nav item from AppShell sidebar
4. Remove RunsPage lazy import from App.tsx
5. Update RunsPage table row navigation from `/runs/:id` to `/workflows/:workflowId/runs/:id`
6. Move RunsPage content into a RunsTab component or inline in WorkflowsPage
7. Update CommandPalette reference from /runs to /workflows

URL structure stays: /workflows, /workflows/:id, /workflows/:id/runs/:runId
definitionOfDone: WorkflowsPage has Templates + Active Runs tabs
Runs nav item removed from AppShell sidebar
No dead imports or references to standalone /runs

implementationPlan.description:
Extract RunsPage table into a RunsTab component.

Create `dashboard/src/components/workflows/RunsTab.tsx` by extracting the core content from RunsPage.tsx:
- Move STATUS_OPTIONS, timeAgo, formatDuration, stepsProgress helpers
- Move SkeletonRows, Pagination sub-components
- Move the full runs table with status filter pills, cursor-based pagination
- Change row click navigation from `navigate(/runs/${run.id})` to `navigate(/workflows/${run.workflowId}/runs/${run.id})` — use workflowId from the run record (WorkflowRun type already has workflowId field)
- Use RunStatusBadge (epic rail) for run status display
- Export as default `RunsTab` component
implementationPlan.note: Extracted RunsPage content into RunsTab component. Changed row click navigation from /runs/:id to /workflows/:workflowId/runs/:id. Removed page header (will be provided by WorkflowsPage tabs).

implementationPlan.description:
Refactor WorkflowsPage to add tab navigation with Templates + Active Runs tabs.

- Add tab state: `const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'templates' | 'runs'>('templates')`
- Add pill-tab bar below the page header (use existing pattern from ApprovalsPage/PolicyPage: `rounded-full border border-border p-1` with `bg-accent/15 text-accent` for active)
- Templates tab label with LayoutGrid icon, Active Runs tab label with Play icon (lucide-react)
- Templates tab renders existing workflow cards grid (current WorkflowsPage content)
- Active Runs tab renders `<RunsTab />` imported from `components/workflows/RunsTab`
- Keep 'Create Workflow' button in header (visible on both tabs)
implementationPlan.note: Added Templates + Active Runs pill tabs with icons. Templates shows existing workflow cards grid, Active Runs renders RunsTab component. Create Workflow button visible on both tabs.
